title: Set Seedance 2.5 to generate a 30-second 1080p video by explicitly specifying…
content:
Set Seedance 2.5 to generate a 30-second 1080p video by explicitly specifying duration (30s) and resolution (1080p) in the prompt.  
Use two reference images and assign them fixed roles (Image 1 = protagonist identity, Image 2 = monster identity) while instructing “exact identity” and “keep designs consistent” to prevent character drift.  
Lock the visual style by specifying pure black-and-white 1930s rubber-hose 2D animation constraints (solid black ink on white, thick uniform outlines, flat fills only, no grey/gradients) and add period-film artifacts (scratches, dust, gate weave, frame flicker, uneven exposure).  
Control motion cadence by directing “bouncy animation held on twos” plus “squash-and-stretch” and “expressive faces” for classic cartoon timing.  
Storyboard the generation with timestamped beats (0–5s, 5–12s, 12–17s, 17–22s, 22–27s, 27–30s) to enforce clear scene progression and pacing.  
Prevent unwanted overlays by explicitly banning text elements (no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark) and banning background music while requesting “sound effects only” with a detailed SFX list.  
Use a strong negative prompt to avoid common failure modes (color/grey shading/gradients, photorealism/3D/CGI/anime, realistic fire, gore/injuries/death, extra monsters, multiple copies, deformed limbs, pouch becoming large).  
Maintain a key prop constraint by repeatedly stating the pouch must remain visibly small and never grow while still holding oversized objects, to preserve the gag consistently across shots.

es.content:
Configura Seedance 2.5 para generar un video de 30 segundos en 1080p especificando explícitamente la duración (30s) y la resolución (1080p) en el prompt.  
Usa dos imágenes de referencia y asígnales roles fijos (Image 1 = identidad del protagonista, Image 2 = identidad del monstruo), indicando “exact identity” y “keep designs consistent” para evitar el drift de los personajes.  
Bloquea el estilo visual especificando restricciones de animación 2D rubber-hose de los años 30 en blanco y negro puro (tinta negra sólida sobre blanco, contornos gruesos y uniformes, solo rellenos planos, sin grises ni degradados) y añade artefactos de película de época (rayones, polvo, gate weave, frame flicker, exposición irregular).  
Controla el ritmo del movimiento indicando “bouncy animation held on twos” junto con “squash-and-stretch” y “expressive faces” para lograr el timing clásico de cartoon.  
Estructura la generación con beats marcados por timestamp (0–5s, 5–12s, 12–17s, 17–22s, 22–27s, 27–30s) para imponer una progresión clara de escenas y el ritmo.  
Evita overlays no deseados prohibiendo explícitamente elementos de texto (no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark) y la música de fondo, mientras solicitas “sound effects only” con una lista detallada de SFX.  
Usa un strong negative prompt para evitar fallos comunes (color/grey shading/gradients, photorealism/3D/CGI/anime, realistic fire, gore/injuries/death, extra monsters, multiple copies, deformed limbs, pouch becoming large).  
Mantén una restricción clave del prop repitiendo que la pouch debe permanecer visiblemente pequeña y nunca crecer, aunque siga conteniendo objetos sobredimensionados, para preservar el gag de forma consistente en todos los planos.

fr.content:
Configurez Seedance 2.5 pour générer une vidéo de 30 secondes en 1080p en spécifiant explicitement la durée (30 s) et la résolution (1080p) dans le prompt.  
Utilisez deux images de référence et attribuez-leur des rôles fixes (Image 1 = identité du protagoniste, Image 2 = identité du monstre) tout en indiquant « exact identity » et « keep designs consistent » afin d’éviter toute dérive des personnages.  
Verrouillez le style visuel en spécifiant des contraintes d’animation 2D rubber-hose des années 1930 en noir et blanc pur (encre noire pleine sur fond blanc, contours épais et uniformes, aplats uniquement, sans gris ni dégradés) et ajoutez des artefacts de film d’époque (rayures, poussière, gate weave, scintillement des images, exposition irrégulière).  
Contrôlez le rythme du mouvement en demandant « bouncy animation held on twos » ainsi que « squash-and-stretch » et « expressive faces » pour un timing de cartoon classique.  
Structurez la génération avec des temps clés horodatés (0–5 s, 5–12 s, 12–17 s, 17–22 s, 22–27 s, 27–30 s) afin d’imposer une progression claire des scènes et un bon rythme.  
Évitez les superpositions indésirables en interdisant explicitement les éléments textuels (no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark) et la musique de fond, tout en demandant « sound effects only » avec une liste détaillée de SFX.  
Utilisez un strong negative prompt pour éviter les modes d’échec courants (color/grey shading/gradients, photorealism/3D/CGI/anime, realistic fire, gore/injuries/death, extra monsters, multiple copies, deformed limbs, pouch becoming large).  
Maintenez une contrainte sur l’accessoire clé en répétant que la pochette doit rester visiblement petite et ne jamais grandir tout en contenant des objets surdimensionnés, afin de préserver le gag de manière cohérente d’un plan à l’autre.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 で 30 秒・1080p の動画を生成するよう、prompt 内で duration（30s）と resolution（1080p）を明示的に指定します。  
2 枚の reference image を使い、それぞれに固定の役割を割り当てます（Image 1 = protagonist identity、Image 2 = monster identity）。同時に “exact identity” と “keep designs consistent” を指示して、character drift を防ぎます。  
純粋な白黒の 1930 年代 rubber-hose 2D animation の制約（白地に黒インクのみ、太く均一なアウトライン、フラットな塗りのみ、グレー／グラデーションなし）を指定して visual style を固定し、さらに時代映画風のアーティファクト（scratches、dust、gate weave、frame flicker、uneven exposure）を加えます。  
“bouncy animation held on twos” に加えて “squash-and-stretch” と “expressive faces” を指示し、classic cartoon のタイミングに合わせて motion cadence を制御します。  
timestamp 付きの beats（0–5s、5–12s、12–17s、17–22s、22–27s、27–30s）で generation を storyboard 化し、明確な scene progression と pacing を強制します。  
不要なオーバーレイを防ぐため、text 要素（no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark）を明示的に禁止し、background music も禁止したうえで “sound effects only” と詳細な SFX list を要求します。  
強力な negative prompt を使って、よくある失敗モード（color/grey shading/gradients、photorealism/3D/CGI/anime、realistic fire、gore/injuries/death、extra monsters、multiple copies、deformed limbs、pouch becoming large）を回避します。  
重要な小道具の制約として、pouch は常に視認できるほど小さいままで、巨大な物体を入れていても決して大きくならないよう繰り返し明記し、各 shot を通して gag が一貫して保たれるようにします。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5에서 30초 분량의 1080p 비디오를 생성하도록, 프롬프트에 재생 시간(30s)과 해상도(1080p)를 명시적으로 지정한다.  
두 개의 참조 이미지를 사용하고 각각의 역할을 고정한다(Image 1 = 주인공 정체성, Image 2 = 몬스터 정체성). 동시에 “exact identity”와 “keep designs consistent”를 지시해 캐릭터 드리프트를 방지한다.  
시각적 스타일은 순수한 흑백의 1930년대 rubber-hose 2D 애니메이션 제약으로 고정한다(흰 바탕에 진한 검은 잉크, 두껍고 균일한 외곽선, 평면 채색만 사용, 회색/그라데이션 없음). 여기에 시대적 필름 아티팩트(scratch, dust, gate weave, frame flicker, uneven exposure)를 추가한다.  
모션의 리듬은 “bouncy animation held on twos”와 “squash-and-stretch”, “expressive faces”를 지시해 클래식 카툰 타이밍으로 제어한다.  
타임스탬프가 있는 비트(0–5s, 5–12s, 12–17s, 17–22s, 22–27s, 27–30s)로 생성 과정을 스토리보드화하여, 명확한 장면 전개와 페이싱을 강제한다.  
원치 않는 오버레이를 막기 위해 텍스트 요소(no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark)를 명시적으로 금지하고, 배경 음악도 금지한 뒤 “sound effects only”와 함께 상세한 SFX 목록을 요청한다.  
흔한 실패 모드를 피하기 위해 강한 negative prompt를 사용한다(color/grey shading/gradients, photorealism/3D/CGI/anime, realistic fire, gore/injuries/death, extra monsters, multiple copies, deformed limbs, pouch becoming large).  
핵심 소품 제약은 반복해서 명시한다. 파우치(pouch)는 항상 눈에 띄게 작게 유지되어야 하며, 큰 물건을 담고 있어도 절대 커지지 않아야 한다고 계속 강조해, 이 개그가 모든 샷에서 일관되게 유지되도록 한다.

pt.content:
Defina o Seedance 2.5 para gerar um vídeo de 30 segundos em 1080p, especificando explicitamente a duração (30s) e a resolução (1080p) no prompt.  
Use duas imagens de referência e atribua a elas papéis fixos (Imagem 1 = identidade do protagonista, Imagem 2 = identidade do monstro), instruindo “identidade exata” e “manter os designs consistentes” para evitar deriva de personagem.  
Trave o estilo visual especificando restrições de animação 2D rubber-hose dos anos 1930 em preto e branco puro (tinta preta sólida sobre fundo branco, contornos grossos e uniformes, apenas preenchimentos chapados, sem cinza/gradientes) e adicione artefatos de filme de época (riscos, poeira, gate weave, flicker de quadro, exposição irregular).  
Controle a cadência do movimento निर्देशando “animação saltitante em twos” junto com “squash-and-stretch” e “expressões faciais expressivas” para um timing clássico de cartoon.  
Estruture a geração com beats marcados por timestamp (0–5s, 5–12s, 12–17s, 17–22s, 22–27s, 27–30s) para impor progressão clara de cenas e ritmo.  
Evite overlays indesejados proibindo explicitamente elementos de texto (sem texto, legendas, cards de título, watermark) e proibindo música de fundo, enquanto solicita “apenas efeitos sonoros” com uma lista detalhada de SFX.  
Use um strong negative prompt para evitar falhas comuns (colorido/sombreamento em cinza/gradientes, fotorrealismo/3D/CGI/anime, fogo realista, gore/ferimentos/morte, monstros extras, múltiplas cópias, membros deformados, bolsa ficando grande).  
Mantenha uma restrição de prop-chave repetindo que a bolsa deve permanecer visivelmente pequena e nunca crescer, mesmo ao carregar objetos grandes, para preservar a piada de forma consistente ao longo dos planos.

zh.content:
将 Seedance 2.5 设置为生成一段 30 秒、1080p 的视频，并在 prompt 中明确指定时长（30s）和分辨率（1080p）。  
使用两张参考图并为它们分配固定角色（Image 1 = 主角身份，Image 2 = 怪物身份），同时要求“exact identity”和“keep designs consistent”，以防止角色漂移。  
通过指定纯黑白的 1930 年代 rubber-hose 2D 动画约束来锁定视觉风格（白底上的纯黑墨线、粗且统一的轮廓线、仅使用平涂、不要灰色/渐变），并加入那个时代电影的瑕疵效果（划痕、灰尘、gate weave、frame flicker、曝光不均）。  
通过“bouncy animation held on twos”以及“squash-and-stretch”和“expressive faces”来控制动作节奏，以呈现经典卡通的 timing。  
使用带时间戳的分镜节拍（0–5s、5–12s、12–17s、17–22s、22–27s、27–30s）来编排生成内容，以确保清晰的场景推进和节奏。  
通过明确禁止文本元素（no text, subtitles, title cards, watermark）并禁止背景音乐，同时要求“sound effects only”并附上详细的 SFX 列表，来防止不需要的叠加内容。  
使用强力 negative prompt 来避免常见失败模式（color/grey shading/gradients、photorealism/3D/CGI/anime、realistic fire、gore/injuries/death、extra monsters、multiple copies、deformed limbs、pouch becoming large）。  
通过反复强调 pouch 必须始终保持可见的小尺寸且绝不能变大，即使要装下超大物体，也要维持这个关键道具约束，从而在所有镜头中一致保留这个笑点。
